title: CETCOR - Cs Korrektor fuer TEM
supported_facts: The manufacturer explicitly states HxBxT=250x396x306 mm, meaning height/width/depth.
Lists compatible TEMs including Titan, Themis and Spectra.
unsupported_claims: No mounting-interface reference plane is given; whether the envelope includes external coupling lenses is unknown.
The entire OL-to-SAD optical path cannot be compressed into 250mm or treated as exact CAD for this instrument.
